verdict.rationale: Restate documents several public programmatic surfaces: HTTP ingress invocation of any handler via the Restate Server, typed SDK ingress clients in TypeScript, Go and Rust, Kafka invocation, an Admin API (including a cluster state endpoint and per-service OpenAPI 3.1 definitions), an Introspection SQL API, and a CLI for managing services, deployments and invocations. Missing for 10: a published top-level OpenAPI spec for the Admin API itself (the probe of standard OpenAPI paths on the docs site returned 404), and independent hands-on reports of driving the API programmatically.
